description.en: Host-side plugin that writes the host-measured context-occupancy reading into the agent's runtime context every turn, and appends two rules to the compaction prompt so generated checkpoints do not restate claims about the remaining token budget.
description.zh: 宿主侧插件：每轮把宿主实测的上下文占用写入运行时上下文，并向压缩提示词追加两条规则，使生成的检查点不再复述关于剩余 token 预算的说法。
